experiment: Three full-scale, three-span continuous lapped purlin assemblies (two Z-section and one C-section, 25 ft spans, through-fastened 'SR' deck) were loaded to failure by vacuum to simulate wind uplift, with dial gages recording web displacements and twist and strain gages recording strains/stresses at each load level, supplemented by pilot screw-connection capacity tests.
title: Simulated Wind-Uplift Tests of Three-Span Continuous Lapped C- and Z-Section Purlin Assemblies

variables.definition: Identification name of the tested assembly or pilot screw-connection specimen as given in the report.
variables.evidence: Table S1, pages 5, 7, 8, 11, 98 (column test_id)
variables.name: Test specimen identifier

variables.definition: Direction of the applied load; all full-scale tests were simulated wind uplift applied as vacuum.
variables.evidence: Table S1 (column load_direction) and header note on vacuum loading
variables.name: Load direction

variables.definition: Cross-sectional shape of the purlin, C or Z, as built in the assembly.
variables.evidence: Table S1 (column section_type)
variables.name: Purlin section type

variables.definition: Nominal depth of the purlin cross-section (8 in. for the Z assemblies, 7 in. for the C assembly).
variables.evidence: Table S1 (column depth_in)
variables.name: Purlin depth

variables.definition: Base steel thickness of the purlin, reported separately for the C-section end spans and center span.
variables.evidence: Table S1 (column thickness_in); header note on the .119/.1119 discrepancy
variables.name: Purlin thickness
variables.note: C-section end-span thickness printed as .119 in Fig. 2b and .1119 in Section 6.

variables.definition: Length of each individual span of the continuous assembly (25 ft).
variables.evidence: Table S1 (column span_ft)
variables.name: Span length

variables.definition: Number of continuous spans in the assembly (three in all full-scale tests).
variables.evidence: Table S1 (column n_spans)
variables.name: Number of spans

variables.definition: Number of parallel purlin lines in the assembly; a column exists but the report never states the number in words, so it must be read off the figures.
variables.evidence: Table S1 (column n_purlin_lines) and header note that the count is not stated
variables.name: Number of purlin lines
variables.note: Column is blank in all rows.

variables.definition: Type of roof panel and its attachment to the purlins (through-fastened 'SR' panel with #14 self-tapping screws).
variables.evidence: Table S1 (column panel_type) and header note describing the SR panel
variables.name: Roof panel/attachment type

variables.definition: Base steel thickness of the 'SR' roof deck panel, stated as t = .021 in. for all assemblies in the table header note.
variables.evidence: Table S1 header note: deck was the "SR" panel, t = .021 in.
variables.name: Roof deck thickness
variables.note: Single stated value, not a column.

variables.definition: Transverse spacing of the purlin lines, stated in the header note as 5 ft for the Z assemblies and about 61 in. for the C assembly.
variables.evidence: Table S1 header note on purlin spacing (Figs. 1a, 2a)
variables.name: Purlin spacing
variables.note: Stated in a note, not a column.

variables.definition: Length of the roof deck cantilevered beyond the outside purlin lines, 8 in. for the Z assemblies and 5.5 in. for the C assembly.
variables.evidence: Table S1 header note on deck overhangs
variables.name: Deck overhang beyond outside purlin
variables.note: Stated in a note, not a column.

variables.definition: Lateral/torsional bracing arrangement used in the final test of each assembly (braces at supports only, with or without intermediate braces or rake channels).
variables.evidence: Table S1 (column bracing) and header note on braces and rake channels
variables.name: Bracing condition

variables.definition: Failure (ultimate) load of the assembly or pilot screw connection exactly as printed in the report, obtained by increasing vacuum pressure until collapse.
variables.evidence: Table S1 (column failure_load_as_printed, with unit in failure_load_unit), pages 5, 7, 8, 11, 98
variables.name: Failure (ultimate) load
variables.note: Printed as approximate values ('about 40', 'about 50' psf); screw-test rows give load per screw.

variables.definition: Verbal description of the observed mode that terminated the test (plastic buckling, screw pull-over, deck tearing).
variables.evidence: Table S1 (column failure_mode)
variables.name: Failure mode

variables.definition: Highest vacuum load level at which dial- and strain-gage readings were recorded during the test.
variables.evidence: Table S1 (column last_recorded_load_psf)
variables.name: Last recorded gage load

variables.definition: Dead weight of the test assembly per square foot of horizontal projection, acting in addition to the applied vacuum pressure.
variables.evidence: Table S1 (column dead_load_psf) and header note on plot origins shifted by the dead load
variables.name: Assembly dead load
variables.note: Different values for C-section end spans and center span.

variables.definition: Yield stress of the purlin steel measured on tensile coupons, reported as individual coupon values by purlin type.
variables.evidence: Table S1 (column yield_stress_ksi); header note quoting Section 6 coupon results
variables.name: Coupon yield stress
variables.note: Reported by purlin type only; Z values repeated for both Z assembly rows.

variables.definition: Applied vacuum (simulated wind uplift) pressure at which each set of dial- and strain-gage readings was taken.
variables.evidence: Appendix tables A2, A3, B1-B3, B6, B7, C2-C9 (columns load_psf / p_psf)
variables.name: Applied uplift load level
variables.note: Some load labels are duplicated or reset ('reset 21', '27 Base') and are preserved as printed.

variables.definition: Raw dial gage reading at each load level, from which displacements are computed; parenthesised or bracketed values are reset readings.
variables.evidence: Appendix B7 (columns g28_rdg...g33_rdg), page 95; Appendix C2 (columns g16_rdg...g19_rdg), page 97
variables.name: Dial gage reading
variables.note: Readings printed as x10^-3 in. in B7 (gage 32 in inches); reset values merged into the reading cell.

variables.definition: Horizontal displacement at an individual dial gage location, obtained from the dial gage readings at each load level.
variables.evidence: Appendix A2 (p.87), B6 (p.94), B7 (p.95), C2 (p.97) — columns u5_in, u6_in, ... u33_in
variables.name: Dial gage horizontal displacement
variables.note: Gage locations are given in Figs. 6, 22 and 37; one B6 header is printed ambiguously as 'u[?]' (taken as gage 19).

variables.definition: Difference between the horizontal displacements of a vertically paired set of dial gages on the same purlin web, used to compute twist.
variables.evidence: Appendix A2 (p.87) and B6 (p.94) — columns u6_minus_u5_in, u2_minus_u3_in, etc.
variables.name: Paired gage displacement difference

variables.definition: Twist of the purlin cross-section expressed as the tangent of the rotation angle, computed from the difference of paired dial gage displacements divided by their vertical separation.
variables.evidence: Appendix A2 (p.87), B6 (p.94), C2 (p.97) — tan_theta_* and u15_u16_tan / u18_u19_tan columns
variables.name: Twist angle (tangent)
variables.note: In Appendix C2 defined explicitly as (U15-U16)/4 and (U18-U19)/4.

variables.definition: Horizontal (lateral) displacement of the mid-height of the purlin web, computed as the mean/interpolated value of the paired dial gage displacements.
variables.evidence: Appendix A2 (p.87), B6 (p.94), C2 (p.97) — um_* and u15_u16_avg_in / u18_u19_avg_in columns
variables.name: Mid-web horizontal displacement
variables.note: In Appendix C2 defined as (U15+U16)/2 and (U18+U19)/2.

variables.definition: Strain gage reading at each gage and load level, recorded in micro in/in on the strain indicator.
variables.evidence: Appendix A3 (p.88), B1-B3 (pp.89-91), C3-C9 (pp.98-104) — columns g1_rdg_microin ... g56_rdg_microin
variables.name: Strain gage reading
variables.note: Some gages printed 'X' (no gage), some readings missing or truncated with [?] markers; gage 32 in Appendix B3 is noted defective.

variables.definition: Stress at each strain gage location, computed from the change in gage reading multiplied by the elastic modulus (reading x 30x10^3/10^6 = reading x .03).
variables.evidence: Appendix A3 (p.88), B1-B3 (pp.89-91), C3-C9 (pp.98-104) — columns g1_stress_ksi ... g56_stress_ksi
variables.name: Stress from strain gage
variables.note: Zero-load rows carry sign markers instead of stresses; many values truncated or contain [?].

variables.definition: Elastic modulus of the steel used to convert strain gage readings to stress, stated in the column definitions as 30x10^3 ksi (factor .03 ksi per micro in/in).
variables.evidence: Column definition in Appendices A3/B1/B2/B3: 'stress from gage 1 (reading x 30x10^3/10^6)'
variables.name: Elastic modulus used for stresses
variables.note: Assumed value, not measured in the tests.
